about: An open format that lets AI agents describe screens, like forms and buttons, for an app to show.

prs.title: Safer setup steps for secret keys in the examples
prs.broken: The example apps told people to type their secret access keys straight into a settings file, with no template showing which keys were needed.
prs.changed: I added template settings files with placeholder values and updated seven setup guides to copy from them.
prs.matters: A documentation change, but it makes leaking a real key by accident less likely.
